title: Headless Techatticup hostages (#2926): freeing an NCR hostage sends an assault alarm on the mine's Legion faction (SendAssaultAlarm Player CaesarsLegionTechMineFaction); the hostage must not turn on the player, and the second hostage's message box must still open

actions.text: Start as anywhere-i-wander.actions.json: Renolds gives VTechatticup stage 10. The trip and the Legionaries in the mine are not walked: the raiders are alive and in place.
The reporter's order: TechMineNCRHostage2REF (0x0012319C) first. Its script's button 1 ends with SendAssaultAlarm Player 0x001400F9 (the issue's decode).

A headless box is modeless (no given menu): ShowMessage leaves a message_shown event in the trace and menu 1001 opens only for the press frame, so the scenario counts the message_shown events of TecMineHostageMSG (0x001231B8), one per hostage.

The player is moved out of the mine in the frame after the first activation (cell 0x001244CD, as quest 0x0014EA0C reaches stage 100: frame 1801 of the #2926 round-2 trace), so the hostage's GameMode block, which runs the Untie branch and its SendAssaultAlarm, waits until the player is back. Return to the hostage before the reads.

hostages: raider 5 alarmed after the first

actions.text: Probe (#2926): one raider of the faction, as the pick reads it (present = not disabled, alive, in the faction). With the engine's log at info for fnv_game::crime the 'assault alarm:' line gives the counts for the whole faction.
